title: Total number of electrons
description: Essential: The response must correctly state N = nLS (or nSL).

title: Current magnitude expression
description: Essential: The response must correctly state I = neSv (or n e S v).

title: Lorentz force derivation
description: Important: The response must derive the single-electron force by relating Ampere force (F = BIL) to the total number of electrons.

title: Final Lorentz force expression
description: Essential: The response must correctly state the final result f = Bev (or B e v).

title: Correct use of definitions
description: Important: The reasoning should correctly use the definitions of current (I = q/t) and charge (q = nSvte) in part (2).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The response may show awareness of unit analysis for the derived quantities.

title: Confusing total vs. moving electrons
description: Pitfall: Penalise if the student confuses the total number of electrons (N) with the number passing a cross-section in part (1) or the derivation.

title: Sign or vector error
description: Pitfall: Penalise if the student incorrectly introduces a negative sign for electron charge in the final scalar magnitude expressions.
